tool_action.public_message: Gemini, de-risk proposal: I’ll give you my light-blue pair, the yellow blocker, and $100 for Park Place. You keep Boardwalk plus a much broader portfolio; I get a blocker so the table doesn’t just orbit dark blue.

final_action.public_message: Grok, final serious bid for the blocker: my full $357 cash for Oriental, no property complications. You get a big war chest while Gemini’s dark blue is live; I get only a cheap counter-monopoly that still needs time and cash to develop.
final_action.private_thought: All-in cash is risky but survivable from Boardwalk because I pass Go before likely payments. Oriental is my only realistic comeback; better to overpay Grok than let Gemini’s dark blues run away. If rejected, stop chasing for now.
